flows.municipalitiesWithPublished: Municipalities with published flows on the chosen day
flows.allFlowsOfSelectionNotOnly: All flows of the selection (not only the top {SHOW}); text starting with = + - @ is neutralised
flows.mapOfPresumedTripRoutesSame: Map of the presumed trip routes; the same flows are listed in the table
flows.routeMostLikelyCycleRoute: Route = most likely cycle route between the cell centres (OSRM), not measured; only operators with stable IDs; flows under {min} trips hidden.
flows.mobilityPulseLinksStartAnd: Flows exist only for operators with permanent vehicle IDs. Voi, Bolt and Dott assign a new ID after every trip; for them, “Estimated” shows statistically estimated flows. Only cell pairs with at least {min} trips per day are shown, and a day only after it has ended.
flows.noFlowFilesInDataSnapshotYet: No flow files in the data snapshot yet.
flows.noCompletedDayWithFlowsYet: No completed day with flows yet.
flows.collectorIsCurrently: The collector is currently collecting {dmy}; a day's flows appear after the day has ended.
flows.chooseAnotherDayOrReload: Choose another day or reload later.
flows.inNoOperatorReportsStable: In {place}, no operator reports stable vehicle IDs on {dmy}.
flows.noCellPairWithAtLeast2Trips: {place}: no cell pair with at least {min} trips on {dmy}.
flows.withStartAndDestinationAll: {v0} with start and destination, all below the minimum threshold.
flows.onThisDayThereAreFlowsIn: On this day there are flows in, among others: {others}.
flows.wholeDayTripsWithStartAnd: Whole day: {fmt} trips with start and destination, {fmt2} in flows, {fmt3} below the minimum threshold{v3}
flows.tripsInMergedFlowsSeveral: {fmt} trips in merged flows (several operators, types or times of day) only under “All” or “Whole day”
flows.reportsNoStableVehicleIdsIn: {op} reports no stable vehicle IDs in {name}.Start and destination of a trip cannot be linked then (and are deliberately not linked). Operator “All” shows the flows of the other operators.
flows.noFlowsForThisSelectionSet: No flows for this selection.Set operator, vehicle type or time of day to “All” or “Whole day”.
flows.startAndDestinationInSame: start and destination in the same cell
flows.straightLineRouteMissingOr: Straight line (route missing or being calculated)
flows.routingNotReachableOfRoutes: Routing not reachable – {ok} of {length} routes, the rest as straight lines
flows.weekTip: Measured flows of one calendar week (Mon–Sun) on cells {CELL500} – operators with stable IDs only
flows.weekHow: Weekly sum, measured: start and end of the same stable ID, Monday to Sunday added up, cells {CELL500}; flows under {min} trips in the week hidden. Route = most likely cycle route between the cell centres (OSRM), not measured.
flows.weekPrivacy: A week appears once after it has ended (no rolling sum, which would reveal single days when compared); only cell pairs with at least {min} trips in the week are published.
flows.weekNoFiles: No weekly flows in the data snapshot yet.
flows.weekNoWeek: No completed week with flows yet.
flows.weekCollecting: The current week ({wk}) appears on the following Monday.
flows.weekNone: No published flows in the week {wk}.
flows.weekNoPair: {place}: no cell pair with at least {min} trips in the week {wk}.
flows.weekOthers: This week there are flows in, among others: {others}.
flows.measuredTip: Start and end of the same ID – operators with stable IDs only
flows.estimatedTip: Expected trips per cell pair from trip starts and trip ends – operators with rotating IDs, no individual trips
flows.estHow: Estimated, not measured: trip starts and trip ends per cell ({CELL500}) are matched statistically per collector run (gravity model with distance decay); values are expected trips per cell pair and day, route = most likely cycle route (OSRM).
flows.estPrivacy: Vehicles are not linked across ID rotation: only counts per cell are stored, estimation runs after the day has ended, and only cell pairs with at least {min} expected trips drawn from at least 5 trip starts are published.
flows.estNoFiles: No estimated flows in the data snapshot yet.
flows.estNoDay: No completed day with estimated flows yet.
flows.estNoPair: In {place} no cell pair reaches 2 expected trips on {dmy}.
flows.estQuality: Quality, checked blind against operators with stable IDs: agreement (CPC) {cpc} (without distance decay {base}), correlation {r}, top 50 reach {top} % of the optimum.
flows.estQualityNone: Quality cannot be checked for this day (no comparison trips with stable IDs).
